verdict.rationale: Riskified is an e-commerce fraud-decisioning product, so telling malicious bots apart from legitimate AI buying agents is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers bot detection, agent identification, or special handling of agent-initiated purchases. The docs describe only generic order decisioning (/decide, /submit, advise), device-data collection via Beacon, and login decisions. The 'Agentforce Commerce' mention is just the renamed Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform integration and has nothing to do with AI buying agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the product distinguishes malicious bots from legitimate AI buying agents, so agent-driven purchases aren't blanket-blocked as fraud
